regions.original:
Angrunds Verkehrswerbung
Vor einem Gleisanschluss des Geländes bitte im B. parken!
regions.translation:
Angrunds Traffic Advertising
Before a railway siding of the premises, please park in B!
regions.breakdown: "Angrunds": Likely a company name in genitive. "Verkehrswerbung": Compound noun (traffic + advertising). "Vor einem Gleisanschluss": "Vor" (before) is a preposition taking dative ("einem Gleisanschluss" - a railway siding). "des Geländes": "des" (of the) is the genitive definite article, "Geländes" (premises) is a genitive noun. "bitte im B. parken!": "bitte" (please), "im B." (in area B, "im" is a contraction of "in dem"), "parken" (to park) is an infinitive used as a polite command.

where_youd_see_it: You would see this sign near a private railway siding, indicating where to park.
cultural_note: Railway sidings (Gleisanschluss) are common in industrial areas in Germany, allowing direct rail access for businesses. Parking regulations are often specific to these private areas.
